items.question: Are the programs really free?
items.answer: Yes, 100%. There is no paid version, no trial and no limit on sites, URLs or log lines, and the code is open source. You only pay if you choose to: search API providers for your own keys, or OctopusOn credits for one connection to all of them.

items.question: What is GEO?

items.question: Is OctopusOn SEO Crawler really free?
items.answer: Yes. It is 100% free and open source (MIT or Apache-2.0). There is no paid version, no licence key and no URL limit; the only limits are your computer's memory and disk.

items.question: Is it a Screaming Frog SEO Spider alternative?
items.answer: Yes. It covers the core of a technical SEO crawl for free: spider and list modes, JavaScript rendering, response codes, redirects, canonicals, hreflang, duplicates, structured data, XML sitemaps and exports. A few Screaming Frog features, such as custom extraction and PageSpeed Insights, are not available yet; the full comparison lists them.

items.question: Can it render JavaScript?
items.answer: Yes. It uses the Chrome, Chromium or Edge installed on your computer and compares the raw HTML with the rendered page.

items.question: How many URLs can it crawl?
items.answer: There is no built-in limit: a URL limit of 0 means unlimited. Very large sites are bound only by your computer's memory and disk.

items.question: Does my crawl data leave my computer?
items.answer: No. Crawls run and are stored on your computer. Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed.

items.question: Which systems does it run on?
items.answer: Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux (AppImage, deb and rpm). The octopuson-crawler command-line tool is available for scripts and servers.

data.title: Preguntas sobre la alternativa a Log File Analyser

items.question: ¿Hay una alternativa gratuita a Screaming Frog Log File Analyser?
items.answer: Sí. OctopusOn Log Analyser es gratis y de código abierto, sin límite de líneas de log ni de sitios. Funciona en Windows, macOS y Linux.

items.question: ¿Mis logs salen de mi ordenador?
items.answer: No. Los logs se importan, se guardan y se analizan en local. Solo se descargan las listas públicas de IP de los rastreadores y, si la activas, la base de datos de geolocalización de IP.

items.question: ¿Qué formatos de log puedo importar?
items.answer: Nginx y Apache (formatos combined, common y personalizados), IIS y CloudFront (W3C), AWS ALB y ELB, HAProxy, Traefik, logs JSON de Caddy, Cloudflare, Google Cloud y Akamai, y CSV o TSV. El formato se detecta automáticamente.

items.question: ¿Puede encontrar páginas huérfanas?
items.answer: Sí. Compara la actividad de los bots con una lista de URL, un sitemap XML o una exportación de rastreo para ver las páginas que los bots nunca rastrean y las páginas rastreadas que faltan en tu lista.

items.question: ¿OctopusOn está afiliado a Screaming Frog?
items.answer: No. OctopusOn es un proyecto independiente de código abierto. Screaming Frog es una marca comercial de Screaming Frog Ltd.
